newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Midcontinent diffs firm on Clark outage.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Midcontinent diffs firm on Clark outage.

text.p: U.S. Midcontinent unleaded gasoline and diesel fuel differentials firmed in Chicago on Monday following a weekend fire that idled an alkylation unit at a key regional refinery, traders said.
Clark Refining & Marketing Co said a 6,400 barrel per day alkylation unit at its 80,515 barrel per day Blue Island, Ill., refinery should be back on line this week.
The unit was idled by a liquid propane pipeline fire early Saturday morning, trimming production of premium unleaded gasoline at the Chicago-area refinery, a refinery spokeswoman said.

Clark was sighted in the market for diesel and unleaded barrels, and the outage sparked higher differentials on low and high sulphur diesel barrels in the Chicago market. "There are buyers, but no sellers," one Chicago trader said.
Chicago prompt low sulphur diesel was bid 1.75 cents under NYMEX November heating oil, with high sulphur talked 4.50 cents under the print with no sellers emerging.
Chicago unleaded gasoline for all October timings firmed to 0.25 cent under to even with NYMEX November unleaded, with premium talked 3.0 cents higher.
Group Three prompt low sulphur diesel eased to 0.75/1.25 cents over the print, with high sulphur easing to 2.0 cents under.
Group Three unleaded for prompt deliveries was talked 1.50/1.25 cent under the print, with premium 3.0 cents higher.
